# SHA-256 of lowercase tokens that must never appear in this public repository.
# Checked by scripts/ci/scrub-gate.mjs. Add one with: node scripts/ci/hash-token.mjs <token>
#
# Only for LONG, UNGUESSABLE tokens (e.g. an internal host name with random parts). A hash of a
# short word, a name or a number can be reversed by brute force, which would publish the very word
# it protects. Put those in the SCRUB_PATTERNS repository secret instead (newline-separated
# regexes); maintainers keep a local copy outside the repository.
